metadata.description: Sandbox for atlas-skills' release process: one plugin, one package, one bundle. Not for analysis work -- use atlas-skills.

plugins.name: remote-h5ad-obs
plugins.description: Read the per-cell obs table out of a remote h5ad over HTTP range requests, without downloading the expression matrix.

plugins.name: author-annotation-columns
plugins.description: Find which obs columns hold the authors' own cell-type, tissue, developmental-stage and disease annotations, as opposed to the portal's standardised fields, cluster indices and QC.

plugins.name: atlas-tools
plugins.description: Bundle: installs author-annotation-columns within a tested version range. Carries no skills of its own.
